title: Cosmic Wanderer
description: A lone hiker with a red backpack stands on a grassy cliff edge, holding a walking stick and gazing upward at a large glowing orb in a starry black sky. Inside the orb, four overlapping women's faces in purple, green, pink, and yellow are visible within a geometric sphere surrounded by geometric symbols and an alien-like creature perched on top.
prompt: A surreal cosmic scene with a hiker wearing a red backpack standing on the edge of a grassy cliff, looking up at a large glowing spherical orb in a black starry sky. Inside the orb are four overlapping stylized women's faces in vibrant purple, green, pink and yellow with long flowing hair, all enclosed in geometric lines. An alien creature with antennae sits on top of the orb. Below the cliff are fields of glowing purple flowers under a purple-hued landscape, with geometric symbols and stars floating in the dark background.
